doraInfoIndicator:
As in a real game, the dora indicator is shown.

For example, if 9-man is shown, the dora is the next tile, 1-man. Count how many 1-man are in the hand. Ura-dora are read the same way.
doraInfoActual:
The dora itself is shown, not the dora indicator.

For example, if 9-man is shown, the dora is 9-man. You do not move on to the next tile as you would with a dora indicator (counting 9-man as 1-man is wrong).

Ura-dora work the same way: the tile shown is the dora itself. Count how many of that tile are in the hand.
doraInfoSettingsLink: Change how dora are shown in Settings
